Notes

Dark Torturers are distant relatives of the diabolic imps. Like all members of the imp family, they enjoy pain and havoc they wreak upon other creatures. Their physical abilities exceed by far those of their cousins, the diabolic imps. Since they lack the magical affinity of the latter, those creatures tend to sell their services to more powerful demons or even some malicious mortals. Given their somewhat lazy and cowardly nature, they prefer to take up the roles of jailers and torturers. There they can indulge their malicious instincts without risking too much in open warfare. Those disgusting qualities have earned this race the fitting name Dark Torturer in the vernacular.

—Tibia Library
It is a relative of the Diabolic Imp. The Dark Torturer's boss is Mr. Punish located in Tafariel's throne room.

Location

Pits of Inferno, Vengoth, Blood Halls, Oramond Dungeon, Oramond Fury Dungeon, Roshamuul Prison, Grounds of Damnation and Halls of Ascension.

Behaviour

They will try to get in melee contact with you. They run in low health, but be careful even then, as they can deal out 800~ combos while running away from you.

A dark torturer attacks in melee range. A dark torturer will retreat at 500 (6.8%, red) health.

Strategy

Run from them and try to shoot them before they catch up with you. They can hit quite hard in close combat.

History

  • The Spring Update 2012 added Great Mana Potions as drops of this creature.
  • As announced on January 28, 2020, the first batch of Hunting Ground Rebalancing changed its XP from 4,650 to 2,651, and reduced its drop rate chance by 60%.
  • As announced on January 30, 2020, the second batch of Hunting Ground Rebalancing changed its XP from 2,651 to 4,650, and reduced its drop rate chance by -55% relative to the first batch reduction.
  • As announced on February 04, 2020, the third batch of Hunting Ground Rebalancing increased its drop rate chance up to +456% relative to the second batch reduction, returning to the original drop chance before the rebalancing.
  • As announced on March 28, 2023, the patch reduced its loot drop by 12%.
